general.notes: Operating temperature printed as -0°C to +70°C. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C not mapped to operating temp fields. Power consumption stated as < 1.0W. Power budget 0 – 12dB. Bit rate support 100 to 155Mbps (Mbps in source, not converted to Gbps). Transmitter min output printed as -19.0dB (footnote 1: average power; max as dBm). Receiver minimum input power -31dBm at 155Mbps, BER 1x10-12, PRBS 231-1. Receiver wavelength range 1260nm – 1600nm is receive-side range, distinct from transmit 1260–1360nm. Typical reach 2km@50/125 µm, 62.5/125µm. Technology Grey SFP. Transmission media MM (2x LC). No minimum distance / no minimum attenuation per overview.
